metadata.title: Monochromatic Blue Band Portrait with Boxed Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic blue-tinted composition featuring layered band portraits anchored by a top-centered, double-bordered typographic box.
excludeWhen: minimalist layouts without borders are requested
modern flat design is the goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic blue image featuring multiple figures in various scales and depths, unified by a central, rectangular graphic element containing stylized, condensed lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Large foreground figure on the right balancing smaller figures on the left
Top-centered geometric box acting as the primary visual anchor
Monochromatic blue palette unifying disparate photographic elements
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue color cast across all elements
Layered depth through varying figure scales

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, close-up figure dominates the right foreground, while smaller full-body and half-body figures occupy the mid-ground and background on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-centered rectangular box containing the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large figure on the right, moves to the central text box, and then scans the smaller figures on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows between figures provide dark negative space that emphasizes the blue highlights.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue for shadows and mid-tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan-tinted white for highlights and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with low saturation, creating a cold, moody atmosphere.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' nested within the vertical space of uppercase neighbors
Vertical 'THE' integrated into the stem of the first letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large custom display type paired with a smaller, widely-spaced sans-serif subtitle within the same frame.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical weight and narrow profile.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochromatic blue-tinted photograph of a group of people in 80s attire, with one large figure in the right foreground and others receding into the background on the left. Ensure deep shadows and bright cyan highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top-centered rectangular box with a double-line border. Inside the top half, place large, ultra-condensed custom lettering. In the bottom half, place a smaller sans-serif subtitle separated by a horizontal line and a central crosshair icon.

verificationChecks: Is the entire image monochromatic blue?
Is the text box centered at the top with a double border?
Does the large foreground figure appear on the right side?
Is the main text ultra-condensed and vertically dominant?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the background
mustRedesign: Any logos or specific band branding
The specific facial features of the individuals
The exact wording of the text

avoid: Color bleeding outside the blue spectrum
Cluttered composition that obscures the central box

postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue tint is uniform across all photographic elements.
Ensure the text box is perfectly rectangular with sharp corners.
Verify the hierarchy between the large foreground figure and the text box.
Confirm the presence of the central icon within the lower text section.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Blue Tint + Layered Portraiture + Top-Centered Double-Bordered Text Box = 80s Rock Aesthetic
